name: @storyengine/mode-freeform
description: Freeform — do/say/think/story play with a goal, a party and no dice, as a package that consumes the SDK exactly as a third party would.
dependencyNote: One dependency, the same one Scene has, and the reason is stronger here: Scene was written before the contract and moved behind it, while this mode was written against it from the first line. If something Freeform needs is missing from `@storyengine/sdk`, that is the contract being wrong and the fix belongs there — which is what a second mode is for (docs/design/19-tech-stack.md §10).
